svg.title: About Akash Yadav and interests
svg.desc: About me, professional capabilities and an animated three-slide interests carousel: coding and learning new technologies, exploring AI tools, gaming, travelling and watching movies.

g.text: I’m Akash, a Junior .NET Developer from Ghazipur,
Uttar Pradesh. I build secure, scalable and maintainable
web applications with ASP.NET Core, from clean REST
APIs to well-structured SQL Server databases.
REST API design with ASP.NET Core Web API
Authentication with ASP.NET Core Identity and JWT
Data access with Entity Framework Core and SQL
Layered architecture with a service layer
MVC web applications with ASP.NET Core MVC
